findings.title: Owned guard close timeout is not recorded as unknown closure
findings.trigger: The guard close callback does not settle inside cleanupRemaining(), or reports a close error.
findings.staticFlow: within(closePromise,...,"cleanup") rejects; runWitness rejects, but work.catch captures the error and work.finally sets workSettled=true. The top catch marks failed but waiting for work now settles immediately. server.listening may already be false from close initiation, so final cleanupUnknown remains false even though the actual close callback was not observed successfully.
findings.impact: The failure outcome stays failed; this is not a false pass. However rm(temporaryRoot) may run and succeed, and the60s fail guard may be cleared while guard closure is unknown. That violates the explicit preserve-evidence rule and can leave an owned handle until the outer115/120 bound.
findings.requestedRevision: In a separately named successor, track actual guard-close callback settlement/success (not merely listening). Mark cleanupUnknown on close timeout/error and refuse evidence-directory removal and fail-guard clearing until actual owned close is known. Keep the single original cleanup deadline and60/115/120 bounds; do not add retries or widen deadlines.

findings.title: Required failed-test counters became optional
findings.trigger: A source JSON result contains exact passing selected callbacks/success/numPassedTests but omits numFailedTests or numFailedTestSuites.
findings.staticFlow: The new loop validates each failed/runtime counter only if that key exists. Missing required failure counters therefore skip validation, despite source-audit-contract.requiredResultKeys declaring both and the accepted predecessor requiring both.
findings.impact: Auditor can accept incomplete result grammar instead of failing closed on missing failed-test or failed-suite evidence. This is a narrow adaptation regression, not a demonstrated actual Vitest failure.
findings.requestedRevision: Restore mandatory type(result[key]) is int and ==0 checks for numFailedTests and numFailedTestSuites. Preserve the existing optional numRuntimeErrorTestSuites compatibility check. No new gate or report framework.
